The gbm cohort comprises 580 patients. A subset of 152 patients have expression data, while 194 patients are unsequenced. The cohort was split into a training set of 406 patients and a testing set of 174 patients. Four patients were dropped due to missing overall survival (OS) data, and one patient was dropped due to a nonpositive OS months value.

Several data concerns exist within this cohort. Missingness is substantial for several variables: 284 patients have missing age data, representing 48.97% of the cohort. Similarly, 284 patients have missing sex data, also representing 48.97%. Furthermore, 194 patients have missing data for *mut_TP53*, *mut_PTEN*, *mut_EGFR*, *mut_IDH1*, *mut_NF1*, and *mut_ATRX*, which represents 33.45% of the cohort for each of these variables. Checks for covariates, proportional hazards, and convergence were reported as false.
